satoToken.name: SATO ERC-20
satoToken.role: Token balances, transfers, total supply, and protocol-authorized mint and burn accounting

satoHook.name: SatoHook
satoHook.role: Bonding-curve issuance, redemption, reserve accounting, fee accounting, and protocol constraints

satoSwapRouter.name: SatoSwapRouter
satoSwapRouter.role: Execution router for direct curve buy and sell calls; does not control issuance, reserve custody, or curve pricing

uniswapV4PoolManager.name: Uniswap v4 PoolManager
uniswapV4PoolManager.role: External settlement layer used by the Hook execution path

verification.note: Verify addresses, deployed bytecode, source status, and live state independently before integration.

scope.includes: Canonical Ethereum mainnet protocol contract addresses documented by the SATO community.
excludes: Dynamic balances, reserve values, supply, prices, and holder counts
